text:
maya: Quick sync — need to cut a minimal patch bump to 1.11.1 for the nv-cache OOM fix. Target cutoff 18:00 UTC today. Keep diffs tiny, no new features. Who can take cherry-picks + changelog?

tom: I can handle the cherry-picks. pls drop the exact commits. aiming for minimal risk. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks. Commits are: a7f2e9b (fix nv-cache leak), d4c1a33 (tighten init guards). Both already reviewed on main.

tom: perfect. will cherry-pick to release/1.11.x and run `make release-smoke`.

maya: changelog note: "Fix nv-cache OOM during high-concurrency downstream reads." short and link to PR. jen can you add entry?

jen: on it, will add a single-line entry and link PR #842.

alex: Heads-up for QA: expecting a quick smoke pass only. No regression matrix. @qa-bot please kick a smoke pipeline after cherrypicks merged.

qa-bot: queued: smoke-tests for release/1.11.x (run-id: smoke-1917005). Will post results here.

chris: I can do staging deploy + canary if smoke green. ETA 30m after merge.

tom: cherry-pick commands I'm running: ```
# on release/1.11.x
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b tmp-1.11.1
git cherry-pick a7f2e9b
git cherry-pick d4c1a33
git push origin tmp-1.11.1:release/1.11.x
```

tom: pushed and opened PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/release/pulls/1581

release-bot: branch created release/1.11.x at commit 5b3e9f7, PR #1581 created, labels: patch, urgent.

qa-bot: smoke-tests completed: ✅ 12/12 green, duration 4m 12s. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/smoke-1917005

alex: nice. @chris can you proceed with staging deploy?

chris: kicking staging now, will monitor lat+errors for 15m. will thumbs-up when canary healthy.

chris: staging canary looks stable. 0.0x error rate change, p95 latency unchanged. :white_check_mark:

maya: ok plan: merge PR, tag 1.11.1, quick rollback plan documented (revert PR + rebuild). cutoff still 18:00 UTC — if merged after that we postpone to next window.

jen: changelog entry added and release notes draft updated.

tom: merged PR and pushed tag `v1.11.1-patch` (sha 8f4c2a0).

release-bot: Release v1.11.1 created and scheduled for deploy to production at 18:05 UTC.

maya: big thanks. watch for any post-deploy errors. ping here if issues.

alex: I'll monitor logs and metrics for the next hour.

maya: :rocket: good job team, keeping this minimal paid off.

jen: one follow-up: reminder for next week — add the nv-cache test to nightly regressions so this doesn't sneak back in.

maya: noted. creating a follow-up ticket.
